name: Unchained Monk Tattooed Monk
body:
A tattooed monk finds power in supernatural tattoos they inscribe on their body.

Tattoo (Su or Sp)

Beginning with 1st level, a tattooed monk gains a magical tattoo that empowers them. The tattoo choices are detailed below. They gain another tattoo at 2nd level and every 4 levels thereafter. These tattoos replace the monk’s bonus feats. Activating a tattoo is a swift action unless otherwise stated or if it is constant. The caster level, if applicable, for these tattoos is equal to the tattooed monk’s class level.

Tattoo Options
Bamboo or Bear (Su)

Once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can add the number of tattoos they possess as an enhancement bonus to his Constitution score for 1 round per class level.

Bat or Orchid (Su)

A character with this tattoo gains the power of good fortune, usable once per day. This ability allows the tattooed monk to reroll one d20 roll that they have just made. The character must take the result of the reroll, even if it’s worse than the original roll. The character must declare the reroll before the result of the original roll has been determined.

Black Star or Centipede (Sp)

Once per week, a character with this tattoo can cast shadow walk as a spell-like ability using their class level as the caster level. This ability allows the tattooed monk to cross great distances, but they must end their journey on the material plane. A tattooed monk must be at least 10th level to gain this tattoo.

Bull or Oni (Su)

Once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can add the number of tattoos they possess as an enhancement bonus to their Strength score for 1 round per class level.

Cat or Fire (Su)

Once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can add the number of tattoos they possess as an enhancement bonus to their Dexterity score for 1 round per class level.

Chameleon or Kitsune (Sp)

A character with this tattoo can use an alter self effect once per day per tattoo they possess. This benefit lasts for 1 hour per class level.

Cherry Blossom or Eagle (Su)

Once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can add the number of tattoos they possess as an enhancement bonus to their Charisma score for 1 round per class level.

Chrysanthemum or Peony (Su)

Every hour that a character with this tattoo is in direct sunlight, they heal a number of hit points equal to their level. A daylight spell does not provoke this fast healing; the character must be exposed to real sunlight.

Crab or Tortoise (Su)

A character with this tattoo gains damage reduction 2/magic. This damage reduction improves by 2 for each additional tattoo they possess.

Crescent Moon or Ghost (Sp)

Once per day, a character with this tattoo can use ethereal jaunt as a spell-like ability using their class level as the caster level. A tattooed monk must be at least 14th level to gain this tattoo.

Deer or Lion (Su)

A character with this tattoo gains the Diehard feat.

Dragon or Tiger (Su)

Once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can fight unarmed with a +1 bonus on all attack rolls and deal an extra 1d6 points of damage with a successful attack. This burst of martial arts ferocity lasts for 1 round per class level.

Dragonfly or Wind (Su)

Once per day, a character with this tattoo gains a dodge bonus to their AC equal to the number of tattoos they possess. This benefit lasts for 1 round per class level.

Falcon or Historical Hero (Su)

A character with this tattoo is immune to fear (magical or otherwise). Allies within 10 feet of them gain a morale bonus on their saving throws against fear effects equal to the tattooed monk’s Charisma bonus (if any) plus the number of tattoos they possess.

Fox or Snake (Su)

Once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can add the number of tattoos they possess as an enhancement bonus to their Intelligence score for 1 round per class level.

Full Moon or Mystic Knot (Su)

Once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can gain a +2 luck bonus on a single attack roll, skill check, or ability check.

Ginseng or Sun (Su)

A character with this tattoo can heal wounds in another character by touch. Each day they can heal 1d6 hit points per tattoo they possess. A tattooed monk cannot heal themselves with this ability.

This tattoo is usable a number of times equal to their Wisdom modifier.

Horse or Wasp (Sp)

Once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can use haste on themselves for 1 round per class level.

Lotus or Spider (Su)

To use this tattoo, a character must have the Stunning Fist feat. Instead of a Stunning Fist attack, a character with this tattoo can make an attack that delivers a contact poison. The poison’s save DC is equal to 10 + the tattooed monk’s class level + their Constitution modifier. The poison’s initial and secondary damage is 2 points of Constitution damage.

Using this tattoo counts as one of the character’s Stunning Fist attacks for that day.

Monkey or Spy (Su)

A character with this tattoo gains a +1 competence bonus per tattoo they possess on all Acrobatics, Climb, Open Lock, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth checks.

Mountain or Pine Tree (Su)

A character with this tattoo can activate it to take on the immovability for as much as 1 round per class level, gaining phenomenal durability though they cannot move from the spot where they stand. They gain a +4 bonus to their Constitution and Wisdom scores.

The increase in Constitution increases the tattooed monk’s hit points by 2 points per level, but these hit points go away when the ability’s duration expires or when the character chooses to end it as a free action. These extra hit points are not lost first the way temporary hit points are. While using this tattoo, the tattooed monk takes a –20 penalty on any Dexterity-based skill checks and reduces their speed to 10. They are immune to bull rush and trip attacks. The tattooed monk may use this ability once per day per tattoo they possess.

Ocean or Sky (Su)

A character with this tattoo never needs to eat, sleep, or drink.

Owl or Tidal Wave (Su)

Once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can add the number of tattoos they possess as an enhancement bonus to their Wisdom score for 1 round per class level.

Phoenix or Yin Yang (Su)

A character with this tattoo gains SR equal to their class level + 15. A tattooed monk must be at least 10th level to gain this tattoo.

Rabbit or Scorpion (Su)

As an immediate action usable once per day per tattoo they possess, a character with this tattoo can force an opponent attacking them to use their lowest ability score modifier instead of their Strength or Dexterity score modifier when making the attack roll. The tattooed monk must be aware of the attack and not flat-footed in order to use this ability.

Thief or White Mask (Su)

A character with this tattoo is immune to detect thoughts, detect lies, and any attempt to magically discern their alignment. They also gain a +10 bonus on all Bluff checks.
